<thought>To determine the number of CH₃ groups, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (~10‑30 ppm). By counting the distinct signals in that region, I can infer the number of CH₃ groups. If no such signals are present, the answer will be 0.</thought>
